messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: release v2026.03.18-rc3 -> eu-west1 (10% canary live, will ramp to 100% in 15m if no regressions)

maria: seeing the postdeploy synths starting now. will watch p95/gateway and kv probes.

jon: thanks — can you paste the quicklink to the smoke dashboard?

maria: https://dash.redwood/smoke/eu-west1?synth=needle

lee: FYI short prompt synth p95 jumped to 320ms at 1:45:12 (small fanout), baseline 120ms. no errors.

maria: saw that. KV warmup probe showed prefix cache miss spike too, small blip.

anita: @maria @jon could be prebaked-cache warming variance after the new kernel. opened a quick trace: `trace: /api/gen -> kv-prefill (alloc jitter)`

sre-bot: Alert: synth-p95-eu-west1 exceeded threshold (p95>250ms) — rate 3/5 in 5m

jon: ok hold the ramp. don't push to 100% yet. set canary to 10% indefinitely while we triage.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused by @jon — target remains 10%

maria: digging into logs, looks like one worker pool hit a GC pause during the kernel handshake. patch candidate: pin runtime-kernel v3.4.1 for eu-west1 hotfix.

lee: can we route new canary traffic to another pool instead of pinning? would take longer.

anita: pinning is faster for immediate mitigation. small config flip: `routing.policy.region.canary_pool = pinned-pool`

jon: agree pin for 30m, run synthetic re-check after 10m. If p95 drops under 180ms, then resume ramp. If errors >1% roll back to v2026.03.17.

maria: made the routing pin, re-running needle synth now.

sre-bot: synth check (after pin): p95=138ms, error=0.0%, kv-miss-rate normalized

jon: looks good. keep canary at 10% for 30m, schedule follow-up at +30m in #eng-releases. thanks :thumbsup:

anita: opened follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood/PRJ-9328 "eu-west1 postdeploy kernel pin & observation" — assigned to infra oncall.

lee: adding note to release notes: "Deferred full rollout pending 30m observation".

maria: will circle back if any new spikes. paging @oncall if alerts resume.

deploy-bot: Canary observation timer set for 30m by @jon
